features.name: Storage overview
features.description: Home dashboard showing device storage used versus total (bar or ring) and how much the app can free, by category, after a first scan of the photo library.
features.reason: Device capacity comes from URLResourceValues volume keys; category sizes from PHAssetResource file sizes. On device.

features.name: Duplicate photos
features.description: Group exact or near-exact duplicates (same pixels, re-saved copies, burst copies). In each group the app pre-marks one 'best' photo to keep and the others for deletion; a single bottom button deletes the whole selection showing count and size.
features.reason: PhotoKit fetch plus Vision VNGenerateImageFeaturePrintRequest distance with a tight threshold; runs offline.

features.name: Similar photos with best-shot suggestion
features.description: Group visually similar shots taken close in time. Suggest the best one using face capture quality (eyes open, smiling, looking at camera), sharpness, and whether the user edited or favourited it. User can override the pick; the rest are pre-selected.
features.reason: Vision feature print with a looser threshold plus VNDetectFaceCaptureQualityRequest and PHAsset.isFavorite / hasAdjustments. On device.

features.name: Swipe to keep or delete
features.description: Card stack of photos: swipe left to mark for deletion, right to keep. Marked items go to an in-app bin that is reviewed before the actual deletion.
features.reason: SwiftUI DragGesture; deletion through PHAssetChangeRequest.deleteAssets, which also shows the system confirmation.

features.name: In-app bin with final review
features.description: Everything marked is collected in a review grid; user can restore items and then confirm one deletion. Photos then land in the system Recently Deleted album for 30 days.
features.reason: Core safety promise of the app. Local state plus one PhotoKit change request.

features.name: Videos sorted by size
features.description: List all videos sorted largest first with size and duration so the biggest can be removed first.
features.reason: PHAssetResource file size per video; on device.

features.name: Screenshots and screen recordings
features.description: Separate category with all screenshots (mediaSubtypes .photoScreenshot) and screen recordings for bulk review.

features.name: Live Photos to still
features.description: Convert Live Photos into still photos to save the video part, showing before and after size.
features.reason: Possible by saving the still image as a new asset and deleting the original; metadata and album membership need care, so it is a second step.

features.name: Video compression
features.description: Re-encode a large video at low, medium or high quality, preview, and show size before and after; save the compressed copy and optionally delete the original.
features.reason: AVAssetExportSession presets on device; quality loss needs a clear preview and confirmation.

features.name: Chat app media
features.description: Group photos that came from messaging apps (WhatsApp, Snapchat, WeChat) for bulk deletion.
features.reason: Only heuristics are possible (saved without camera EXIF, album named after the app); no reliable public source attribute.

features.name: Keep list
features.description: Mark photos as protected so they never show up again in cleaning suggestions.

features.name: Duplicate contacts merge
features.description: Find contacts with the same name or number and merge them into one, with optional backup first.
features.reason: Contacts framework (CNContactStore, CNSaveRequest) works offline; reviews report contacts lost, so it needs a backup (vCard export) and careful confirmation. Outside the photo-only promise.

features.name: Email cleaner and unsubscribe
features.description: Connect a mail account, group messages by sender and category (social, promotions, spam) and bulk delete or unsubscribe.
features.reason: Requires signing in to a mail provider and network access; against the no-account, no-network rule.

features.name: iCloud cleaning
features.reason: The app only sees the Photos library; iCloud Photos follows automatically. No separate iCloud API without network/account.

features.name: Storage and battery widgets
features.description: Home screen widgets showing storage used percent and battery level.
features.reason: WidgetKit can show free storage; battery is outside the app's one job.

features.name: Cleaning results screen
features.description: After deletion show before/after storage and the space freed, plus a celebration and 'time saved'.
features.reason: Space freed is the one figure of the session; drop confetti and time-saved claims.

features.name: Subscription paywall and trial
features.description: Weekly or lifetime subscription with a 7-day trial; free tier limits deletions (about 5 photos per day) or adds ads.
features.reason: No subscriptions or in-app purchases in Sbu.

features.name: Ads to unlock deletion
features.description: Watch an ad to delete a small batch in the free tier.

features.name: Rating prompt after deletion
features.description: Ask for an App Store rating after a successful cleanup.
features.reason: Not a user feature; SKStoreReviewController could be considered later but not part of parity.

screens.purpose: Short carousel on value, then photo access request and paywall
elements: Paywall with trial toggle and weekly plan

screens.name: Home dashboard
screens.purpose: Overview of storage and cleaning categories
elements: Category cards: duplicates, similar, screenshots, videos, Live Photos, chat media, contacts, email

screens.name: Duplicates and similar
screens.purpose: Grouped review of duplicates and similar photos
elements: Title with total count and size
Group rows with best photo badge and other photos marked with X

screens.name: Video compressor
elements: Before/after split preview with play button

screens.name: Live Photos converter
elements: Stack of Live Photos with before size

screens.name: Contacts duplicates
elements: List of duplicate pairs with checkboxes

screens.name: Email cleaner
elements: Categories with counts (social, promotions, updates, spam, forums)

flows.name: Clean similar photos
steps: Each group shows suggested best photo, others pre-selected

flows.name: Swipe cleanup
steps: Swipe left or right on each photo

fields.name: category
fields.note: duplicates, similar, screenshots, videos, livePhotos, chatMedia

data_model.storage: Photo library through PhotoKit; scan cache, bin, keep list and stats on device. The listing stresses offline local processing.

monetization.price: Free download; weekly plan (seen at 6.99-13 EUR per week in reviews, 3.99-6.99 USD in public paywall listings), yearly 29.99 USD, lifetime 39.99 USD; 7-day free trial
paywalled_features: Bulk deletion beyond about 5 photos per day
monetization.notes: Paywall appears right after onboarding; trial requires a card and auto-renews. Many reviews say they were charged at trial start.
